title: 3BR Family-Friendly Private Home on 30A with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Stay at Moon Glow, a 3BR, 3.5BA 30A vacation home with a sleeper sofa, a community pool, a full kitchen, and Xplorie benefits. Sleeps 10.
description_expanded: Enjoy the evening sunsets and Gulf breezes from the balconies of Moon Glow, a lovely family-friendly, 3-level home. Only a short stroll to the beach and steps from the community pool. Come and take advantage of all the amenities this great vacation home has to offer.Enjoy all the comforts of home with large flat-screen TVs in the living room and all the bedrooms, modern appliances in the kitchen, and cozy bedding to relax and unwind after a day of fun in the sun.The 1st floor features an open-concept entertaining space: the living area with a sleeper sofa and the dining area with seating for 6. Don't forget about the chef-friendly kitchen .. it is stocked and ready for you to create some amazing meals. Also on this main floor you'll find the laundry room and a convenient half bath. The 2nd level is where you will find the main bedroom with a king bed and private porch, and another bedroom with 2 full beds and a large walk-in closet. The 3rd floor tower room boasts a comfy queen bed, a wet bar, and another private porch with stunning Gulf views. All bedrooms have attached private bathrooms.With great dining options just across the street, and fun shopping destinations within walking distance, you’ll find this vacation home a most convenient and comfortable vacation getaway.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, tv, vanity area, private balcony access, tub and shower area bathroomBedroom 2: 2 Twin Full beds, tv, private balcony access, tub and shower area bathroomBedroom 3: Queen bed, tv, private balcony access, private bathroomSofa in the living room pulls out to a queen bed.Your stay at Moon Glow comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Beach set-up of 4 chairs/2 umbrellas is provided: Mar. 1 - Oct. 31 (weather permitting).* Saturday to Saturday rental in season.* Parking for 3 cars.* Sorry, no pets allowed.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
